upanishads.meaning: The word 'Upanishad' means 'sitting near a teacher' to gain deep knowledge. It represents learning directly from a wise teacher about truth and life.
upanishads.introduction: The Upanishads are philosophical teachings that explain the deeper meaning of life, the self, and the universe. They focus on inner understanding rather than external rituals. They guide a person from ignorance to knowledge and from confusion to clarity.
core_purpose: To understand the true nature of reality
To guide humans toward freedom from suffering (Moksha)

key_teachings.explanation: Your real identity is not your body or mind, but your inner consciousness. This is eternal and does not change.
deep_understanding: You are not your thoughts or emotions
Your true self is peaceful and unchanging
Knowing your true self removes fear and confusion

key_teachings.explanation: Brahman is the infinite reality that exists everywhere and in everything.
deep_understanding: Everything in the universe is connected through Brahman
It is beyond form, name, and limitations
It is pure existence, knowledge, and bliss

key_teachings.explanation: The Upanishads teach that your inner self (Atman) and the ultimate reality (Brahman) are one.
deep_understanding: You are not separate from the universe
Realizing this unity is true knowledge

key_teachings.explanation: Freedom from suffering and the cycle of birth and death.
deep_understanding: Achieved through self-knowledge, not external success
Leads to permanent peace and fulfillment

key_teachings.explanation: Not knowing your true self is the root of suffering.
deep_understanding: People identify with body and mind instead of true self
This creates fear, desire, and confusion

famous_mahavakyas.simple_explanation: Your true self is the same as the ultimate reality
I am not separate from the universe
Pure awareness is the ultimate truth
Your inner self is divine reality

major_upanishads.name: Isha Upanishad
major_upanishads.focus: Living in the world with spiritual awareness
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Balance material life and spiritual wisdom

major_upanishads.name: Kena Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: The power behind thinking and perception is divine

major_upanishads.name: Katha Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Understanding death leads to understanding life

major_upanishads.name: Mundaka Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Spiritual knowledge is greater than material knowledge

major_upanishads.name: Mandukya Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Explains waking, dream, deep sleep, and pure awareness

major_upanishads.name: Chandogya Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Everything is connected to one reality

major_upanishads.name: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad
major_upanishads.simple_understanding: Explores self, universe, and ultimate truth in depth

learning_path: Start by understanding the idea of the self (Atman)
Reflect on the unity of Atman and Brahman
Gradually move toward deeper understanding and realization
modern_relevance: Helps reduce stress by understanding the true self
Gives clarity about purpose and identity
Provides deep answers to existential questions
Promotes inner peace in a fast-paced world
